description:
For more information about Stanford's online Artificial Intelligence programs visit: https://stanford.io/ai

This lecture covers:
1. Regularization
2. Stochastic Gradient Descent
3. Momentum, AdaGrad, Adam
4. Learning rate schedules

To learn more about enrolling in this course visit: https://online.stanford.edu/courses/cs231n-deep-learning-computer-vision
To follow along with the course schedule and syllabus visit: https://cs231n.stanford.edu/

Zane Durante
PhD student at Stanford University, Computer Science

View the entire course playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLoROMvodv4rOmsNzYBMe0gJY2XS8AQg16
